notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping Galvanic Juggernaut.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
